fixed_scenarios.name: fall_line_reference
fixed_scenarios.label: REFERENCE — FALL LINE
fixed_scenarios.description: Clean fall-line reference retained only as a control.

fixed_scenarios.name: left_oblique
fixed_scenarios.label: LEFT-OBLIQUE FALL
fixed_scenarios.description: Body and velocity are oblique toward camera-left with mild roll.

fixed_scenarios.name: right_oblique
fixed_scenarios.label: RIGHT-OBLIQUE FALL
fixed_scenarios.description: Mirror of the left-oblique fall at a different downhill speed.

fixed_scenarios.name: left_crossed
fixed_scenarios.label: BODY/VELOCITY DISAGREE — LEFT
fixed_scenarios.description: Body points left of the fall line while velocity crosses right.

fixed_scenarios.name: right_crossed
fixed_scenarios.label: BODY/VELOCITY DISAGREE — RIGHT
fixed_scenarios.description: Mirrored heading/velocity disagreement with opposite roll.

fixed_scenarios.name: hard_left_compound
fixed_scenarios.label: HARD COMPOUND FALL — LEFT
fixed_scenarios.description: Large heading error, cross-slope velocity, and body roll combined.

fixed_scenarios.name: hard_right_compound
fixed_scenarios.label: HARD COMPOUND FALL — RIGHT
fixed_scenarios.description: Mirror hard case to expose one-sided policies or geometry exploits.

fixed_scenarios.name: hard_left_crossed_roll
fixed_scenarios.label: HARD CROSSED/ROLLED FALL — LEFT
fixed_scenarios.description: Extreme heading, cross-slope velocity, and roll have mixed signs.

fixed_scenarios.name: hard_right_crossed_roll
fixed_scenarios.label: HARD CROSSED/ROLLED FALL — RIGHT
fixed_scenarios.description: Mirror of the randomized shallow-plant outlier found by audit.
